item.title: : Buy One Scoop-Get One Free the next time you visit!
item.description:
Serving local Kreider Farms ice cream daily. Lots of great vegan options. Come choose your favorite flavor & treat a friend!

Nestled in the heart of historic downtown Lancaster, the Vintage Candy Shop offers a nostalgic trip down memory lane, with hundreds of novelty and retro candies. item.title: : Halloween Ghost Tours of Lancaster
item.description: Get in the spirit of the season with spine-tingling tales of haunted mansions, eerie cemeteries and spirits that roam the night! item.title: : Improvised Shakespeare 101 With Renee!
item.description:
Discover how to improvise in Shakespeare’s style in this advanced improv class.

About the Class: Love. Jealousy. Betrayal. Ambition. Shakespeare used powerful emotions to tell timeless stories that still captivate audiences today–and you can too! Learn the building blocks of improvised Shakespeare including language patterns, narrative devices, and character archetypes to create a larger-than-life Shakespearean comedy on the spot. This class will add techniques to your improv toolkit to use in improvised Shakespeare and beyond. This class requires students to have completed LIP's Improv 201 or Artistic Director approval. Students must be 18 or older for this class.

This Class will run Wednesdays from 7pm-9:30pm on the following dates: 10/7, 10/14, 10/21, 10/28, 11/4, 11/11, 11/18, [no class 11/25], and 12/2. This class has a class show on Thursday 12/3 at 7:00pm! Ticket sale close at the end of the day on Sunday 10/4/26.

Important: Please check your email the week prior to the start date of your class for any updates.

To qualify for the class show you must:

  1. Adhere to the Lancaster Improv Players' Code of Conduct.
  2. Attend at least six of the eight sessions (ideally all eight).

Tickets are on sale until end of day Sunday 10/4!
item.ns2:location: Lancaster Improv Players,8 West King Street, Lancaster, PA 17603, USA

item.title: : Sketch Level 1 With Bill!
item.description:
An Introduction to Sketch Writing!

About the Class: Learn the fundamentals of comedy sketch writing in this fun, highly practical Sketch 101 class. Taught by LIP co-founder Bill Dewan, you will generate your own funny premises, build vivid characters and scenes, and leave with original sketches. Discover a toolkit of repeatable techniques you can use for live shows, digital content, or just making your friends laugh.

Topics Covered:

  • Basic Comedy & Theater Concepts
  • Script Construction & Formatting
  • Brainstorming
  • Lists & Clustering
  • 7 Word Stories
  • Monologues & Blackout Scenes
  • Story Structure

Improv or writing background is preferred, but the first class will be an “Improv 010” refresher session that is part of the course.

Some notes: Each class session is two hours. YOU WILL HAVE TWO TO FIVE HOURS OF WEEKLY HOMEWORK. This class will be a “no-AI zone.” Using it would defeat the purpose of signing up. The class will end with a table read of our work. This is the first in a series of three LIP sketch courses.

This class will be a hybrid styled class! Most of the sessions will be online. The first session will be in person at a location to be determined (you will be notified via email) and the final sessions will be in person as well.

Students must be 18 or older for this class!

This Class will run Sundays from 1pm-3pm on the following dates: 10/11, 10/18, 10/25, 11/1, Off 11/8, 11/15, 11/22, 11/29, and 12/6. This class has a class show on Sunday 12/13 at 4pm!

To qualify for the class show you must:

  1. Adhere to the Lancaster Improv Players' Code of Conduct.
  2. Attend at least six of the eight sessions (ideally all eight).

Ticket sale are on sale until end of day Thursday 10/8!

About the Teacher: Bill Dewan is a freelance writer, nonprofit storyteller and a founding member of Lancaster Improv Players. Bill has performed improv at the NYC Improv Fest, the Baltimore Improv Festival, the SteelStacks Improv Festival, and in bustling cities like Atlanta, New Orleans, Philadelphia and just outside of Ephrata. Bill has studied improv at Upright Citizens Brigade and sketch writing at Second City. Bill has started many uncompleted novels.
item.ns2:location: Lancaster Improv Players,8 West King Street, Lancaster, PA 17603, USA

item.title: : History\, Lore & Trivia with Adam Zurn and Benton Webbber
item.description:
Join Historic Rock Ford as we welcome Adam Zurn and Benton Webber for a fun afternoon of "History, Lore & Trivia" in the Rock Ford Barn. First, Adam Zurn of Uncharted Lancaster will present "Legendary Tales from the Mighty Susquehanna River." After Adam's presentation, Benton Webber will host his "Revolutionary Lancaster Quiz Bowl." Questions and answers will be in a Quiz Bowl format with teams of four being created. The Rock Ford barn will be set up so that guests will pick a table to sit at upon arrival for Adam's presentation and then those tables of four will become teams for the Quiz Bowl. Meet up with your friends and make a team or join a group at a table and make some new friends!

Adam Zurn's presentation will be from 2 PM to 3 PM followed by Benton Webber's Quiz Bowl from 3 PM to 4 PM. This event will be held in the Langmuir Education Room located on the first floor of the Rock Ford Barn.

This event is free but registration is required and seating is limited!
item.ns2:location: Historic Rock Ford,881 Rockford Road, Lancaster, PA 17602, USA

item.title: : Sandeep Das: Raga\, Rhythm\, & Rasa
item.description:
Experience the healing power of music with Grammy-winning Tabla maestro and Guggenheim Fellow Sandeep Das. This intimate chamber music concert explores the emotional sentiments of Indian Classical Music known as the Navarasa. Fully relax onstage on a cushion or comfortable chair, or in our spaced-out auditorium seating, as you immerse yourself in the mesmerizing dialogue of exotic instruments, intricate compositions, expressive phrasing, spontaneous improvisations, and joyful folk melodies.

Adults $25 | Students $17
item.ns2:location: Ware Center for the Arts,42 North Prince Street, Lancaster, PA 17603, USA

item.title: : Ragtime the Musical
item.description: A sweeping musical adaptation of E.L. Doctorow’s novel that follows three fictional families in pursuit of the American Dream at the dawn of the 20th Century: Black pianist Coalhouse Walker, Jr. and his beloved Sarah, Jewish immigrant Tateh and his little girl, and a wealthy white family led by matriarch Mother. All grasping for the same dream, if only they can hold on to it.
item.ns2:location: Fulton Theatre,12 North Prince Street, Lancaster, PA 17603, USA
